It looks like you're asking: **"What is the square root of 2?"**

The square root of 2 ($\sqrt{2}$), also known as Pythagoras' constant, is an irrational number.

To 20 decimal places:
$$\sqrt{2} \approx 1.41421356237309504880\dots$$

Common quick approximations:
- **$1.414$** (standard 3-decimal approximation)
- **$\frac{99}{70} \approx 1.4142857$** (fractional approximation)
